map.收获损失率（机器/人工）评估适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessment best for?
map.输入理论产量、实际收获量与分项损失，计算总损失率并与行业参考值比较（参考值仅作参: Enter theoretical yield, actual harvest, and measured component losses to compute the total loss rate and compare it with industry reference values (reference only).
map.总损失量 = 田间落粒 + 脱粒/清选 + 未分项（未分项 = 理论产量 − 实: Total loss = field shatter + threshing/cleaning + unclassified (theoretical yield - actual harvest - itemized losses, floored at 0); measured recoverable total = actual harvest + total loss; loss rate = total loss / measured recoverable total x 100%.
map.按样框法分层统计落粒与脱粒清选损失，剩余差额记为「未分项（漏割/夹带等）」，三项: Tally shatter and threshing/cleaning losses by quadrat sampling; the remaining gap is recorded as unclassified (missed-cut/entrained). All three feed the main loss rate, with measured recoverable total (actual harvest + total loss) as denominator. If itemized losses exceed theoretical yield - actual harvest, the itemized sum is used and a check prompt appears. Machine 3.0% and manual 2.0% are industry reference values only; this page compares against them and makes no pass/fail verdict.
map.测定联合收割机作业损失：总损失量 = 落粒 + 脱粒清选 + 未分项（漏割/夹带: Measure combine harvester operation loss: total loss = shatter + threshing/cleaning + unclassified (missed-cut/entrained); loss rate = total loss / measured recoverable total x 100%.
map.对比机收与人工收割的损失差异，评估机械化经济性。: Compare machine vs manual harvest loss differences to assess mechanization economy.
map.按样框法布点取样（布点思路参考 GB/T 8097 的谷物收获损失测定方法）。: Lay out sampling quadrats (point layout follows the GB/T 8097 grain harvest loss measurement approach).
map.在 2 m×0.5 m 样框内收集落粒 18 g，样框对应面积可收穗粒折算 62: Within a 2 m x 0.5 m quadrat, 18 g of shattered grain was collected; the quadrat's recoverable ear grain converts to 620 g, so plot loss rate = 18/620 ~ 2.9% (sampling illustration). Compare the multi-point field average with this page's reference value (machine 3.0%); the reference comes from industry experience and is not an acceptance conclusion. If above it, fine-tune header height, drum speed, and travel speed.
map.机收损失率的参考值是多少？: What are the reference values for machine-harvest loss?
map.本页机收参考值 3.0%、人工参考值 2.0%，来自行业经验，仅用于比较，不构成: This page uses 3.0% for machine harvest and 2.0% for manual harvest, drawn from industry experience, for comparison only; it is not an acceptance or pass/fail conclusion. If above the reference, check header height, drum speed, and travel speed.
map.取样点怎么布才准？: How to lay out sampling points accurately?
map.按对角线或棋盘法在全田随机布 10~20 个样框，避开地头转弯段；每块地单独统计: Place 10-20 quadrats randomly across the field by diagonal or checkerboard method, avoiding headland turning zones; count each plot separately, avoid using a single point for the whole field.
map.机械收获参考值≤3%，人工收获≤2%（经验参考，非验收标准）: Machine harvest reference <=3%, manual harvest <=2% (experience-based, not an acceptance standard)
map.田间落粒损失受作物品种、成熟度和天气影响: Field shatter loss is affected by crop variety, maturity, and weather
map.机械收获应调整割台高度、转速和清选风量: Machine harvest should adjust header height, speed, and cleaning airflow
map.最佳收获期为蜡熟末期至完熟初期: Best harvest window is late waxy-ripe to early full-ripe
map.收获后应及时晾晒，含水率超标会增加储存损失: After harvest, dry promptly; excess moisture raises storage loss
map.输入理论产量、实际收获量与分项损失，计算总损失率与分项损失率，并与行业参考值比较: Enter theoretical yield, actual harvest, and component losses to compute total and component loss rates and compare them with industry reference values (reference only).
map.损失率 = 总损失量 / 实测可收总量 ×100%: loss rate = total loss / measured recoverable total x 100%
map.与行业参考值比较（不判定合格与否）: Compare with industry reference values (no pass/fail verdict)
